acceptanceCriteria: Cargo package metadata and all versioned release documentation consistently declare v0.2.70; v0.2.68 remains immutable failed-publication history and is never an installation baseline.
Release CI and policy checks pass from the reviewed default branch and produce immutable public artifacts with manifest, SHA256, SBOM, provenance, attestation, and runtime identity bindings.

Post-release acceptance uses only the downloaded public v0.2.70 artifact in isolated temporary roots, records a truthful receipt, proves cleanup and forbidden-root isolation, and validates the same binary for self-governance.
The WI-548 parity batch remains closed and promoted; no active Work Item, stale branch, or untracked closure artifact remains before release.
goal: 生成可审计的 v0.2.70 发布基线，确保包身份、文档、CI、公开资产、供应链证明和 adopter acceptance 一致。
intent: 发布 v0.2.70：承接已审查合并的参考源逐文件比对批次，更新运行时版本与发布文档，并用公开不可变 Release artifact 完成发布验收。
outOfScope: 重新使用 v0.2.68 失败 tag

scenarioCoverage.expected: Package identity and tri-language release documentation consistently declare v0.2.70 while v0.2.68 remains immutable failed-publication history.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo metadata, version consistency, source archive, documentation, and release policy checks before tagging.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public v0.2.70 archives, checksums, SBOM, provenance, attestation, and release manifest agree with the immutable tag and downloaded bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After publication, download only public assets, verify digests, and run isolated adopter and N-1 acceptance without source or workspace fallback.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The published binary passes explicit-repository health checks and closure leaves a visible human Outcome, clean base, and exact branch/worktree cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Install the downloaded v0.2.70 binary, run inspect/status/doctor/agent doctor, then verify closure and documentation promotion.
